zh-CN.title: 广场等级权限判断修复
items: 广场会读取最新成长等级，已达到 LV6 的成员可正常使用语音发言
更新序号现在按当日发布次数持续递增

en.title: Square level access fix
items: Square now reads the latest growth level so members at LV6 and above can post voice statements
Release sequence numbers now increase with every update published on the same day
